name: repo-tools
description: General repository-management commands and skills for safe worktrees, CI monitoring, testing policy, PR delivery, harness maintenance, autonomous work, complexity sweeps with optional legacy and diagnostic analyses, Renovate maintenance, and skill evals.

interface.longDescription: Loads authoritative worktree-hygiene, GitHub CI-monitoring, testing-policy, PR-delivery (land-pr), harness-maintenance, autonomous-work, complexity-sweep (complexity, legacy and diagnostics), Renovate-maintenance and skill-evals skills for general repository management.
defaultPrompt: Create a safe worktree and land this pull request through checks, review, merge, and cleanup.
Improve this repository's documentation and skills from observed workflow failures.
Analyze complexity, retired legacy paths and obsolete diagnostics, or process this repository’s Renovate queue.
